launchSection.title: The Region's First E-Commerce Free Zone
paragraphs: Setting up in Dubai CommerCity (DCC) Free Zone means entering the region's first and only free zone dedicated entirely to e-commerce businesses. Strategically located next to Dubai International Airport, CommerCity is designed to support online retailers, logistics providers, digital platforms, and tech-driven companies.

Whether you're an online retail start-up, an established e-commerce brand expanding into the Middle East, a logistics and fulfillment provider, or a digital service company — DCC offers everything you need to scale. From state-of-the-art warehouses to streamlined customs and logistics facilities, it gives businesses the advantage of speed, efficiency, and global connectivity.

At Setup Zone Dubai, we make your CommerCity setup simple and stress-free. Our team handles the entire process — from company formation and license selection to visas, compliance, and operational setup.

items.q: How long does it take to setup a business in Dubai CommerCity?
items.a: With our expert advice and support, you can setup your business in 3-5 working days thanks to DCC's fast track licensing application process and fully digital process.

items.q: What kinds of companies can I register in DCC?
items.a: DCC supports e-commerce brands, digital marketplaces, software and SaaS companies, AI and tech providers, logistics and fulfillment companies, digital marketing agencies, media production firms, and business consultancies.

items.q: Can I have 100% ownership of my company in Dubai CommerCity?
items.a: Yes. DCC allows 100% foreign ownership with no local Emirati sponsor required — you have complete authority over operations, profits, and decision-making.

items.q: Is DCC only for e-commerce businesses?
items.a: While DCC is the first dedicated e-commerce free zone in the UAE, it also supports tech startups, logistics providers, digital agencies, media production companies, and consulting firms.
No. DCC offers 0% corporate and personal income tax — a significant benefit for startups and global e-commerce brands looking to serve the Middle East and beyond.

items.q: What type of workspace can I get in DCC?
items.a: DCC offers premium fitted offices, shell & core spaces, smart desks, coworking spaces, dedicated warehouses, 3PL support, event venues, food halls, retail spaces, and customizable fulfillment centers.

items.q: How does warehousing and logistics operate in DCC?
items.a: DCC operates 24/7 with an onsite customs team. You get access to bonded warehouses, cross-border delivery management, inventory management centers, last-mile logistics, DCCWay digital clearance, and Logiflow blockchain integration.

items.q: Can I apply for employment visas with Dubai CommerCity?
items.a: Yes. We handle investor visas, employment visas for your team, and family sponsorship — complete visa and immigration compliance support through DCC.

items.q: Is DCC a green/sustainable free zone?
items.a: Absolutely. DCC has 100% LEED Certified buildings, energy-efficient logistics centers, smart design amenities, and dedicated waste recycling facilities aligned with Dubai's Green Economy Vision.

items.q: Why would I consider Setup Zone Dubai for setting up my DCC company?
items.a: With over a decade of experience, we handle company registration, trade name approval, visas, office/warehouse allocation, bank account assistance, compliance (ESR, AML, UBO), license renewals, and digital launch & branding.
